title: frugal warmstart CLI and quant profile initiator
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Adds a CLI flow and backend plumbing to generate tenant warmstart recommendations and initial quantization profiles; safe defaults and telemetry included.
description:
Context and motivation: Customers with sporadic traffic report high per-token costs during cold starts and inconsistent quality when we aggressively apply quantization without warmstart signals. This PR introduces a small, user-facing CLI and server-side companion that seeds tenant-specific warmstart hints and produces conservative quant-profile starters (FP16 / int8-q4hf templates) so teams can get predictable unit economics without manual profiling. The goal is to lower first-token cost spikes, reduce failed warmups, and give SREs productized knobs to tune warmstart/quant behavior.

Summary of changes and design: - New CLI command: `redwood econ warmstart init --tenant <id> --strategy coarse|fine --telemetry-opt-in` that emits a JSON artifact and optional S3 upload. - Server: cost-suggester service gains an API (/v1/warmstart/suggest) used by the CLI and by onboarding flows; suggestions include batch size hints, cache TTL targets, and a candidate quant-profile name. - Quant profiles: three starter profiles added under config/quant_profiles/{starter_fp16,starter_q4hf_coarse,starter_q4hf_conservative}. Each profile has metadata (expected latency delta, memory footprint, fallback path). - Safe rollout: suggestions are advisory; runtime honors tenant policy and can automatically fallback to a compatible model variant if latency or accuracy regressions are detected. - Telemetry: emitted events (prefill.suggested, warmstart.applied, quant.proposed) and a small SDK helper to tag telemetry with Linear/Jira keys.

Checklist (what's included): - [x] CLI implementation and tests - [x] Backend API and unit tests - [x] Starter quant profiles (3) and docs - [x] E2E smoketest harness that runs a warmstart flow against local runtime - [x] Telemetry hooks and GDPR-friendly opt-out - [x] Docs/console copy for onboarding flow

Commits (high level): 1) feat(econ/cli): add `warmstart init` command and JSON exporter (author: Priya) 2) feat(econ/service): add /v1/warmstart/suggest endpoint, recommendations proto and validation (author: Priya) 3) perf(runtime): safe fallback mapping for quant profiles; lightweight checks added to routing layer (author: Evan) 4) docs(econ): onboarding docs and CLI examples (author: Maya) 5) test(e2e): add warmstart smoketest + CI step (author: Carlos)

Files/areas changed (high level): - cmd/redwood/cli/warmstart.go (new) - internal/econ/suggester/service.go (new) - internal/econ/suggester/api.proto (new) - config/quant_profiles/starter_fp16.yaml - config/quant_profiles/starter_q4hf_coarse.yaml - config/quant_profiles/starter_q4hf_conservative.yaml - runtime/router/quant_fallbacks.go - docs/console/warmstart.md - tests/e2e/warmstart_smoke_test.go - ci/workflows/warmstart-smoke.yml - telemetry/events_prefill.go

Small illustrative snippet (quant profile header): "name: starter_q4hf_conservative\ndescription: conservative q4hf profile for tenants with sporadic traffic; favors latency stability over max compression\nexpected_latency_pct_increase: 5\nfallback_profile: starter_fp16" (files include more metadata for rollout gates).

Review conversation (summary): - Evan Zhou (reviewer): requested the telemetry flag be explicit and opt-out by default for EU tenants; flagged a concurrency edge in the suggester cache. - Priya Raman (author): responded by adding `--telemetry-opt-in` and updated suggester cache to use tenant-scoped mutex + TTL eviction (commit 2). - Carlos Mejía: ran the e2e smoke locally, reported a flaky test (warmstart_applies_when_model_ready) tied to timing; author adjusted retry/backoff in the test harness. - Maya Patel: asked to add a short console doc and a few suggested UX copy edits; author updated docs. - Evan re-requested one small rename (prefill.suggested -> warmstart.suggested) for telemetry consistency; author applied and CI re-ran. After CI green, Evan approved and Carlos gave final +1.

CI and gating: - Unit tests: pass - E2E warmstart smoke (flaky-run gated to allow one retry): pass on re-run - Lint/format: pass - Integration: pass on staging cluster (synth load) - Total run time: ~18m. CI notes: initial CI run failed due to missing env var in ci/workflows; fixed in second commit. CI status: pass.

Risk and fallback: This change is low-risk by design: suggestions are advisory, runtime will not force quantization unless tenant policy permits it. Starter quant profiles are tagged as non-destructive and the router includes a conservative fallback to FP16. Telemetry is opt-in for sensitive regions. There are no database schema changes.

Migration and rollout plan: - Merge to main behind feature flag `econ_warmstart_v1` - Gradual canary: enable for 1% of tenants and run warmstart_suggested -> no-apply telemetry to validate signals - After 2 weeks of signal validation, enable apply-for-advised-tenants option and monitor latency/quality SLOs - If regression > 3% p95 latency or quality loss on eval sets, auto-disable for the cohort and revert suggestions on that tenant

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main after approvals and green CI. Changelog/release note added by author.
